comparison.objective: Cap four pens with matching caps and sort them by color.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated cap alignment, press-fit insertion, and planar sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Each matching cap must remain retained and each pen must rest released in its assigned region; detailed pose and clearance limits are given.
comparison.reason: Press-fitting and sorting pens do not test latch release, extraction-tool guidance, or opposing push-then-pull loads.
